title: Frontier Launches Nonstop Service From Boise Airport to Las Vegas
summary: To celebrate, America’s Low Fare Airline is offering fares starting at $59*
body_markdown:
**BOISE, Idaho – Sept. 10, 2026** – Frontier Airlines (


[Nasdaq: ULCC](https://ir.flyfrontier.com/) ) launched new nonstop service today from Boise Airport (BOI) to Harry Reid International Airport in Las Vegas (LAS). The route will operate four times per week and complement Frontier’s service to Denver, which began last year when the airline made its return to BOI.


To celebrate the new service, America’s Low Fare Airline is offering fares starting at $59.*


“This is an exciting day for Frontier and for consumers as we launch this new route from Boise,” said Josh Flyr, vice president of network and operations design, Frontier Airlines. “We are on a mission to prove that air travel can be both high value and low cost, and we look forward to welcoming travelers on board this new service to Las Vegas so they can see why Frontier is America’s Low Fare Airline.”

Frontier Airlines has introduced sweeping changes to its product and customer service offerings, ushering in **‘The New Frontier.’** Among the enhancements is UpFront Plus seating, an upgraded seating option with extra leg and elbow room in the first two rows of the aircraft. Customers in UpFront Plus enjoy a window or aisle seat with extra legroom and a guaranteed empty middle seat. The airline also now offers


[unlimited companion travel](https://www.flyfrontier.com/frontiermiles/companion-travel) for its most loyal customers, with the flexibility to choose a different companion on every Frontier flight. Debuting in 2026, Frontier will begin offering First Class seating, combining unmatched comfort and space at Frontier’s trademark affordable prices.


Frontier continues to innovate with its industry-leading frequent flyer program, **Frontier Miles** ,


** which allows members to earn miles and points quickly and get rewarded for each dollar spent on Frontier products. For the 2026 year, Elite status is attainable at only 10,000 points and offers perks such as priority boarding and free bag(s) depending on status level. Like the airline, Frontier Miles is also family friendly, offering easy family pooling of miles for Elite members and making it simple for families to enjoy rewards together.


[Joining is free](https://www.flyfrontier.com/myfrontier/frontier-miles?mobile=true) .


***About the Promotional Fare Offer:**


Tickets must be purchased by 11:59 pm Eastern time on Sep. 15, 2026. Sale fares are valid for non-stop travel on select days of the week, Oct. 1, 2026, through Nov. 19, 2026. 21-day advance purchase is required. Not all markets are available for all dates of travel. Round trip purchase is not required. All travel rules will apply, including Frontier Airlines' Contract of Carriage.
